instruction: Guide me on enabling VLC's minimal view to reduce clutter and present just the basic playback options.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view=1). Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric function to verify the VLC config file. The setting reduces UI clutter by showing only essential controls. No custom functions needed - reuses existing VLC evaluators.

Expected value is semantically correct: qt-minimal-view=1 enables minimal view mode
Postconfig appropriately kills and restarts VLC to ensure config changes are saved and visible
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses expected_qt_minimal_view correctly
Data flow is logically sound: postconfig ensures state → getter reads config → metric verifies setting → expected provides correct value
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies all requirements in the instruction (enabling minimal view mode)
